about_the_game:
About the Demo:

The demo version of Goblin Dungeons lets you experience the core gameplay mechanics. You'll encounter:

  • the first location with various enemies and a final boss;

  • two explicit scenes;

  • the combat system;

  • a system of random events, including unconventional and spicy situations.

Goblin Dungeons is a roguelike RPG with adult elements. Fight dangerous foes, master powerful magic, and experience sensual encounters in a dark fantasy world on the brink of collapse.

The world of Erotis has fallen to the goblins. Most life is wiped out, and the survivors are enslaved. Only the ancient elven priestesses still had hope — performing a secret ritual to summon help from another world.

You are Ellie, a girl who died in our world and was revived by a forgotten god. To return home, you must destroy the Goblin Lord. Gifted with magic and immortality, you rise again after every death — stronger than before.

Can you fulfill the contract and save Erotis — or will you remain trapped in an endless cycle of death and rebirth?
